body:
Oh how do I begin... I am 19 now.. But it started when I was 12.
7th Grade My Best Friend A (now dead from heroin OD) He got in a fight and broke his hand and got lots of hydrocodone, Which started my opiate addiction.  From there is the usual, percocets, Oxycontin and Heroin.  I was on 5 Vials of H or 4 80mg Oxycontins everyday for about a year and went to rehab.  Out of rehab I was in Outpatient counseling.  Only to relapse a few times until I thought I should try to get on some kind of program.
Well methadone was everyday and I lived far away so I had to get on bupes.  I was on bupes for about a year and a half and trying to get off this stuff is almost impossible.  I mean the withdrawals aren't as BAD as OC or dope, but they are way longer.  No sleep, sweating/cold,  those are the most annoying things.  I didn't really encounter the whole knee//joint pain but for 15 days and nights I could not control my body temp no matter how many shirts I took off or put on or blankets I took off or put on I could not sleep.
So now I relapsed again because the withdrawals from trying to get off Bupes are so hard.  This is about my 7th time trying to get off bupes and it doesn't matter if I take 1mg or 8mg or .001mg for some reason I still have withdrawals.
It's very hard to get off these Bupes.
